SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is the Qur’an considered a miracle?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the miraculous nature of the Qur’an to strengthen iman
2. explain the language of the Qur’an for better understanding
3. identify different styles of the Qur’an for better understanding
4. appreciate the miraculous nature of the Qur’an as a divine scripture
